split_contract.arm_selection_population: inner-selection fold only; this is train-side round-budget selection
split_contract.outer_fold_usage: already-consumed development OOF, evaluated only after selected/latest checkpoints are frozen and never called untouched validation

pilot.probe_annealing_scope: linearly from 0.20 to 0.05 over rounds 1--90 exactly as the paired K4/K16 source, then fixed at 0.05 for rounds 91--160

actor_updates.step_cap_semantics: apply once after all K microsteps; cap only and never enlarge a naturally smaller cumulative round update

prefix_reproduction.only_registered_change_after_round_90: continue the same K16 loop for 70 rounds with probe radius held at 0.05 sigma

checkpoint_selection: lowest inner absolute Query mean cost over rounds 0--160; round zero eligible and first minimum wins ties

evaluation_contract.primary: deterministic direct center warm-relative gain G_w = J_warm - J_actor
evaluation_contract.round0_relative_role: learning-curve diagnostic only; never a policy qualification metric
evaluation_contract.warm_role: external deterministic Query-evaluated center reference only; never an Actor input, label, weight, anchor, loss, or reward

decision_gate.population: inner selected checkpoints only; outer fold is corroborating consumed development evidence
decision_gate.comparison_source: the paired K4/K16 90-round source arm gamma1_k16
decision_gate.pass: accept that rounds 91--160 add reliable K16 learning; only then choose the next single-variable mechanism test
decision_gate.fail: stop increasing round budget and diagnose plateau or speed/variant conflict

inner_warm_gate.note: train-side mechanism gate only; passing does not authorize deployment or consume sealed formal/test
